# Settings

`src/config/settings.py`, read from the environment or the repo's `.env` (`RAKSHAQUANT_ENV_FILE` points elsewhere, or `none` for no file). Names are case-insensitive; unknown keys are ignored, so an old `.env` still loads. Secrets are never logged or shown. Risk limits are separate: see [risk.md](risk.md).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | 'dev' \| 'paper' \| 'demo' \| 'test' | 'dev' | Runtime environment; selects the state directory. The month run uses 'paper'; 'demo' is for simulated/replayed data; 'test' is for the test suite. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | 'DEBUG' \| 'INFO' \| 'WARNING' \| 'ERROR' | 'INFO' | Level for the JSON log file under var/logs/ |
| `VAR_DIR` | Path | unset | Root of all runtime files (default <repo>/var): per-environment state plus the shared tape/, logs/, reports/, reference/, models/, datasets/ and archive/. |
| `STATE_DIR` | Path | unset | Absolute directory for this environment's state (default <var_dir>/<environment>). Relative values resolve against the repo root, never the CWD. |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | Groq API key (optional: only for roles that use groq:) |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | OpenAI API key |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | OpenRouter API key |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | Anthropic API key |
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | str | 'http://localhost:11434/v1' | Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint |
| `LLM_COMPAT_BASE_URL` | str \| None | unset | Any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint (provider 'compat') |
| `LLM_COMPAT_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | Key for 'compat' |
| `LLM_TIMEOUT_S` | float | 20.0 | Per LLM call |
| `LLM_BREAKER_FAILURES` | int | 3 | Consecutive failures that open a model's breaker |
| `LLM_BREAKER_COOLDOWN_S` | float | 120.0 | How long an open breaker skips the model |
| `LLM_CACHE_ENABLED` | bool | True | Reuse a stored reply for an identical prompt and model |
| `LLM_ROLE_VETO` | str | '' | Book C veto (online, entry window) |
| `LLM_ROLE_VETO_FALLBACKS` | str | '' | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_VETO_EFFORT` | str \| None | unset | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_REVIEW` | str | '' | Nightly post-trade review (offline) |
| `LLM_ROLE_REVIEW_FALLBACKS` | str | '' | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_REVIEW_EFFORT` | str \| None | unset | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_EXPLAIN` | str | '' | Trade explanations (offline) |
| `LLM_ROLE_EXPLAIN_FALLBACKS` | str | '' | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_EXPLAIN_EFFORT` | str \| None | unset | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_LABEL` | str | '' | Teacher labels (offline, batch) |
| `LLM_ROLE_LABEL_FALLBACKS` | str | '' | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_LABEL_EFFORT` | str \| None | unset | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_RESEARCH` | str | '' | Weekly research memo (offline) |
| `LLM_ROLE_RESEARCH_FALLBACKS` | str | '' | - |
| `LLM_ROLE_RESEARCH_EFFORT` | str \| None | unset | - |
| `USD_INR` | float | 88.0 | USD->INR for LLM cost accounting |
| `LLM_BUDGET_DAILY_INR` | float | 200.0 | All roles, per IST day (0 = unlimited) |
| `LLM_BUDGET_ROLE_DAILY_INR` | dict[str, float] | {} | Per role, per IST day, e.g. {"veto": 50} |
| `LLM_BUDGET_PER_DECISION_INR` | float | 10.0 | Per decision_id (0 = unlimited) |
| `LLM_OPENROUTER_REFERER` | str | '' | Optional HTTP-Referer sent to OpenRouter (app attribution) |
| `LLM_OPENROUTER_DENY_DATA_COLLECTION` | bool | True | Ask OpenRouter to route only to no-data-retention providers |
| `LLM_ANTHROPIC_FALLBACKS` | bool | True | Anthropic server-side refusal fallbacks (where supported) |
| `ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED` | bool | True | Poll NSE's announcements RSS feed during the session |
| `ANNOUNCEMENTS_URL` | str | 'https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/RSS/Online_announcements.xml' | The RSS feed (polled no faster than its <ttl>) |
| `DECISION_LAYA_ENABLED` | bool | True | Use local Laya when the decision-local extra is installed |
| `DECISION_LAYA_CHECKPOINT` | 'english' \| 'multilingual' \| 'typed-decisions' | 'multilingual' | Fastest on CPU (docs/plan/decision-model-benchmark.md) |
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | secret \| None | unset | Jev (TypeSafe) key |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` | str | 'jev-1.13.0' | Pinned Jev model |
| `DECISION_ESCALATE_LOW` | float | 0.35 | - |
| `DECISION_ESCALATE_HIGH` | float | 0.65 | - |
| `INFRA_COST_INR_PER_DAY` | float \| None | unset | Power, data and API plans per day, for the daily report |
| `EXPERIMENT_FILE` | Path \| None | unset | The experiment definition (default src/config/experiment.yaml) |
| `DECISION_SHADOW_PCT` | float | 0.2 | Laya-only states also sent to Jev to measure agreement |
| `DHAN_CLIENT_ID` | str \| None | unset | DhanHQ client ID (optional for local paper trading) |
| `DHAN_ACCESS_TOKEN` | secret \| None | unset | DhanHQ access token (optional for local paper trading) |
| `DHAN_BASE_URL` | str | 'https://api.dhan.co/v2' | DhanHQ API base URL (use https://api.dhan.co/v2 for live) |
| `EXECUTION_MODE` | 'local_paper' \| 'shadow' \| 'dhan_paper' \| 'live' | 'local_paper' | The requested venue. The v2 engine trades on the simulated broker only: anything but local_paper/shadow is ignored, with a warning. |
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | secret \| None | unset | Telegram bot token from @BotFather |
| `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` | str \| None | unset | Your Telegram chat ID from @userinfobot |
| `TELEGRAM_ENABLED` | bool | True | Enable Telegram notifications |
